rows.label: VAS coverage rate, based on Malaria Consortium pilots

rows.explainer:
20%-60% 8-17 40% comes from a previous model's central estimate of historic coverage. While last year's actual coverage was 86.6%, suggesting higher counterfactual coverage, MC has since discouraged VAS delivery through MNCHWs, justifying  our assumption here that lower coverage would occur without this program.

Source: Malaria Consortium, "Evaluation of the effect of integration of vitamin A supplementation with Seasonal Malaria Chemoprevention on Maternal Newborn and Child Health Weeks in Niger state, Nigeria," 2024 (unpublished).

rows.label: Units of value per dollar given to GiveDirectly
rows.explainer: GiveWell reports this model's result in multiples of cash transfers. Multiplying by GiveWell's value of a dollar to GiveDirectly converts it into units of value per dollar, so it ranks against the other models. Older sheets used older moral weights; the multiple of cash is the comparable number across years.
